scope: simulation-only numerical evidence; not experimental evidence

conventions.response: p_d = (p_plusX - p_minusX) / 2, corrected by zero-detuning b0

physics_boundary.response: dissipative mesolve with T1 and T2
physics_boundary.flux_coordinate: analytic transmon dispersion inverted on the local [0.5, 1] branch; used only for simulation truth and scoring, never estimator input; S3 is restricted to the physically realizable candidate interval because the wider rotating-frame detuning grid extends above the branch maximum

cost_boundary: counted solver calls only; not acquisition time or hardware speed
